title: The header checkbox ticks only the rows loaded so far
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Exactly 35 inventory parts whose numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-HDR, numbered -01 to -35) are active at {Location-A}.
  • The browser window is no more than 1080 pixels tall, so 30 rows do not all fit on screen.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box.
  3. Do not scroll the list.
  4. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  5. Click Deactivate parts.
  6. Click the checkbox in the header row.
  7. Click the checkbox in the header row again.
  8. Click the checkbox in the header row again.
  9. Scroll the list down to the bottom until no more rows load.
  10. Click the X at the right end of the dark bar.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: The bar reads "30 selected": the list loads 30 parts at a time, so only the 30 rows loaded so far are ticked (the line under the table reads "30 records selected.").
  • Step 7: The bar reads "0 selected" and no row is ticked.
  • Step 8: The bar reads "30 selected" again.
  • Step 9: The 5 remaining parts load (35 rows in all) and are not ticked; the bar still reads "30 selected", exactly the number of ticked rows (35 loaded − 5 unticked = 30).
  • Step 10: Bulk mode ends and no part changed status (all 35 are still on the Active tab).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S2-R6, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.6 (Inactive tab, Activate parts), board 4.9 (Branch: more than 200 ticked), 13 Oct copy. Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan" (7 Oct 2026), §3 Technical Decisions D24. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R6: “The checkbox in the header ticks or clears every row loaded in the list. The list loads 30 parts at a time as the user scrolls, so it ticks only the rows loaded so far. The count in the bar shows exactly how many parts will change.”
  • Tech plan §3 Technical Decisions (D24): “Show "N records selected." under the table in bulk mode (boards 4.3, 4.9).”
